notes.title: GDWC Finalists 2025 Summer Season - Proceduralism
notes.notes: [p]We’re excited to share some amazing news!!!| [b]Palette Cleanser[/b] has been nominated as a [b]Finalist in the GDWC 2025 Summer Season – Proceduralism Award![/b] 🏆[/p][p][/p][p]This recognition means a lot to us, as it highlights the creative systems and design choices we’ve poured into the game. It’s an honor to see our work celebrated among so many talented developers worldwide.[/p][p]A huge thank you to everyone who has supported us so far. Your encouragement keeps us motivated to keep building and improving. [/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates soon, and in the meantime, here’s a little celebratory badge we’re proud to share:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409198/cb0a29d1117508c5eed5f632e0f24644f0acd923.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Farewell from Team 1 & Last Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]This will be our final update for [i]Palette Cleanser[/i]. As of today, we are officially ending development and support for the game. The team is disbanding, and we’re all moving on to new adventures, some of us to other projects, others finishing up our studies, and a few just catching up on sleep.[/p][p]We want to thank every single one of you who played, shared feedback, or simply spent time in our little garden world. This game started as a student project, but your support made it feel like something much more.[/p][p]To wrap things up properly, we’ve released one last patch that fixes a handful of lingering bugs and adds some final polish. You can find the full patch notes below.[/p][p]Thanks again for being part of this journey.
– Team 1 

Patch notes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed delayed music after returning to main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ramp animation and lighting[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug with ranged enemies assigned to sprinklers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed airdash spam when jumping on the ramp[/p][/*][*][p]Applied emissive materials to fans[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed collision on breakable walls[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed quitting issue when opening settings from the pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where pressing jump after pausing reopened the pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed settings menu requiring multiple clicks when accessed from pause[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed credits scene speed[/p][/*][/list][p]New [/p][list][*][p]Sprinkler animations[/p][/*][*][p]More desaturated objects [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Official Release
notes.notes: [p][b]That’s right, the brushes are down, the paint’s dry, and [i]Palette Cleanser[/i] is officially released![/b][/p][p]After months of development, testing, and your incredible feedback during the demo and Next Fest, we’re thrilled to finally open the doors to the full experience![/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s new in the full release?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Onboarding tutorials[/p][/*][*][p]Updated mechanics and smoother gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes, polish passes, and performance boosts[/p][/*][*][p]More color,  more animations, more fun[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your support. This project couldn’t have come to life without your enthusiasm, feedback, and chaos.[/p][p]— Team 1[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409198/8d785e811708455c875211da3402a691307079e5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Last Chance to play Palette Cleanser...Demo
notes.notes:
[p]Hey you! Yes, [i]you[/i], the one who still hasn’t played our demo!
[b]Today’s your final shot![/b] It’s the last day of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], and the last day our [i]Palette Cleanser[/i] demo will be up.
[/p][p]After this? It goes back into the hive for its final polishing before [b]FULL RELEASE VERY SOON™[/b].
(Yes, it’s actually happening. No more delays. We’re as surprised as you are.)[/p][p]Huge thanks to everyone who played, broke things, gave feedback, and helped us squash bugs faster than a sugar-rushed bee on a mission.
Your input helped us fix a ton, polish even more, and maybe cry a little (in a good way).[/p][p]So go! Tell your friends! Play the demo one last time before it disappears...[/p][p][/p][p][b]See you very soon. And no, that wasn’t a threat.[/b][/p][p]Much love,
Team 1[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409198/b541c0ef9da044984252ba4c5cbd03af61b71216.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Palette Cleanser is coming to Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
We’re beyond excited to share some big news! Palette Cleanser will be featured in the upcoming Steam Next Fest, running from June 9th until June 16th! This is a huge milestone for our team, and we can’t wait for you to finally get your hands on what we’ve been building.

Help us grow!
If you like what you see (and play), don’t forget to wishlist Palette Cleanser! It’s one of the best ways to support our team and ensure you don’t miss any updates as we head toward launch.

notes.title: Profile Avatars Are Here! 🎉
notes.notes:
Hello Little Cleansers!

We're excited to announce that you can now choose from a set of custom avatars for your profile picture! Whether you're feeling heroic, mysterious, or just want to stand out, there's something for everyone.

Head over to your profile settings and pick your favorite avatar today. Let us know which one you like best, or what you'd love to see added in the future!

- Your dear devs!
